description: Update a coworker's configuration (title, description, provider, input/output, schedule, prompt, tool allowlist, options). Only the given fields change; option changes are merged into the existing options.

effort.description: Reasoning effort, e.g. "low"; "" uses the default

model.description: Model id to run with; omit to use the provider's default

options.description: Task-specific options, e.g. {"targetLanguage":"de"} for docs:translate. Typed fields above take precedence

outputPath.description: Output file or folder when outputType needs one

prompt.description: Custom prompt the coworker runs (agent coworkers, needs a recent AIquila app)

promptId.description: Id of a saved prompt to run instead of `prompt`

provider.description: Provider id: "anthropic", "mistral", "deepseek", "hetzner" or "local"; "" follows the owner setting

thinking.description: Extended thinking for models that support it

tools.description: Allowlist of MCP tool names an agent coworker may call on its unattended runs; [] allows none

name: update_coworker
title: Update Coworker
